text:
```yaml
name: Publish Crates

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      crates:
        description: 'Comma‑separated list of crates to publish (e.g. ic-asset,icx-asset)'
        required: true
        default: 'ic-asset,icx-asset'

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Obtain OIDC token for crates.io
        id: oidc
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const token = await github.actions.getOidcToken({
              audience: 'https://crates.io'
            });
            return token;
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set crates.io token
        run: echo "CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN=${{ steps.oidc.outputs.result }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Publish crates
        run: |
          IFS=',' read -ra CRATES <<< "${{ github.event.inputs.crates }}"
          for crate in "${CRATES[@]}"; do
            echo "Publishing $crate"
            cargo publish -p "$crate" --token "$CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN"
          done
```
